title: Gotham Awards 2026: five films lead with four nominations each
summary: All of a Sudden, Clarissa, La Gradiva, The Invite and Tender Loving Care top the list. The ceremony is on November 30.
image_credit: Representative photo: a vintage film camera. Photo: Joe Haupt from USA / [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vintage_Bell_%26_Howell_Focus-Matic_671_XL_Super_8_Zoom_Movie_Camera,_Made_In_Japan,_Circa_1973_(27938881080).jpg), CC BY 2.0
body:
Nominations for the 36th Gotham Awards are out. All of a Sudden, Clarissa, La Gradiva, The Invite and Tender Loving Care lead with four nominations each.

The awards from the Gotham Film & Media Institute cover 11 categories this year, with 42 films and 25 performances recognised. Olivia Wilde's The Invite and Jesse Eisenberg's The Debut are among the Best Feature nominees.

The winners will be named on November 30, 2026, at Cipriani Wall Street in New York.
